system.description: An imperious fae, leading their realm’s defenses.
system.notes:
Normal | Leader

An imperious fae, leading their realm’s defenses.
Motives & Tactics: Command, nurture, prune the unwelcome

Difficulty: 11 | Thresholds: 6/11 | HP: 6 | Stress: 2

ATK: +1 | Weapon: Melee | 1d8+5 physical

Experience: Leadership +3

Features

Voice of the Fae - Action: Mark a Stress to spotlight 1d4 allies within range of a target they can attack without moving. On a success, their attacks deal half damage.

Sidhe Cage - Action: Spend a Fear to form a cage around a target within Very Close range and Restrain them until they are freed with a successful Brawn Roll. When a creature makes an action roll against the cage, they must mark a Stress.

Momentum - Reaction: When the Sidhe Noble makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.
